items.label: Housing | Different approaches
items.text: Emphasizes public and subsidized housing, vouchers, tenant protections, and repealing the Faircloth limit. (source [4]: https://www.kqed.org/voterguide/sanfrancisco/congress-11th-district/)

items.label: Housing | Different approaches
items.text: Emphasizes more construction, faster approvals, renter protections, and a national goal of 8 million homes. (source [4]: https://www.kqed.org/voterguide/sanfrancisco/congress-11th-district/)

items.label: AI safeguards | Different approaches
items.text: Supports federal rules, worker input, creator compensation, and independent review of high-risk uses. (source [4]: https://www.kqed.org/voterguide/sanfrancisco/congress-11th-district/)
